Deals 5F less hitstun after the first active frame resulting in worse frame advantage on hit beyond the first active frame (can't get any meaty combos on oki)

notes: Second hit (HK) can be canceled into Denjin Charge (down+Punch on Classic / down+attack on Modern) on HIT only for a +10 Knockdown (can even maintain pressure in corner)
Second hit (HK) whiffs on crouching (-18 on block on crouching when it whiffs)
Puts the opponent into a limited juggle state on hit (but the second hit maintains current juggle state, so Drive Rush HP>HK can result in free juggle state after Crumples or Wall splats)
